messages:
maria (eng-security): Heads up — legal asked whether we can support a "pseudonymized" audit export for customers that need PI removed before it lands in their SIEM. They want an opt-in tenant-level flag during onboarding.
ajay (infra): Do they mean redaction or hashing? hashing still lets them correlate across events, redaction loses that.
sarah (prod-ops): From the compliance side they want non-reversible pseudonymization (one-way hash with tenant salt + rotation policy). Prefer no plaintext user identifiers in third-party systems.
jules (customer-success): Customer example: bank wants audit events in Splunk but can't receive raw emails/user ids. They asked for a preview mode to validate mappings before turning on. :eyes:
maria (eng-security): Plan proposal: 1) add tenant flag `export.pseudonymize=true` 2) on export path apply HMAC-SHA256(user_id, tenant_salt_v1) -> put in user_pseudonym field, drop user.email/user_name from payload 3) surface salt rotation event and backfill note. Thoughts?
ajay (infra): Need to consider KMS integration for tenant_salt management. We shouldn't store raw salts in DB. Use KMS to encrypt current salt for each tenant and perform rotation by encrypting new salt and updating pointer. Also must ensure HMAC is computed in the serving plane (not in webhook forwarder) to avoid leaks.
maria (eng-security): Agreed. Also signature header for webhook should still be computed over the final payload we send. Example header: `X-RI-Signature: sha256=hex(HMAC(payload, webhook_secret))` — include that in docs.
sarah (prod-ops): Onboarding flow: customer can create a sandbox S3 destination or Splunk HEC target. We should provide a 'preview' webhook that sends _sample_ pseudonymized events (no live data) and a validation report listing which fields were removed/hashed.
jules (customer-success): +1. Would help support to have a one-click 'replay' of last 100 events into preview mode.
maria (eng-security): Two tricky parts: 1) audit coverage — ensure every control-plane action that references a user_id (RBAC changes, token creation, key rotation) is included; 2) schema compatibility — don't break customers who parse fields by name. Proposal: add `user_pseudonym` and keep a `user_present` boolean for compatibility, while removing `user_email` when pseudonymize=true.
ajay (infra): For SIEM formats: Splunk HEC expects event JSON body; Datadog logs ingestion expects `ddsource`/`service` fields. We'll ship a small transformer module per destination: `transformers/splunk.py`, `transformers/datadog.py`, `transformers/s3_manifest.js`. Keep pseudonymization step before transformation.
maria (eng-security): Automation: devsec-bot should emit a config-check when someone toggles pseudonymize. Example bot note: `devsec-bot: config change detected tenant=acme pseudonymize=true — please confirm KMS key attached and preview delivery validated :white_check_mark:`
devsec-bot: config change detected tenant=acme pseudonymize=true — kms_key=projects/redwood/keys/tenant-acme-salt, preview_sent=true
sarah (prod-ops): We also need to update the schema docs and the audit contract. Suggest a new field in the contract section: `delivery.pseudonymization: { mode: "none|hash", hash_algo: "hmac-sha256", salt_version: "v1" }` and a deprecation note for dropping `user_email` for pseudonymize=true.
maria (eng-security): Security note: hashed identifiers are still linkable within a tenant. If customer needs complete unlinkability, we need per-event ephemeral salts (not ideal) or hash+pepper only known to customer. Document tradeoffs.
ajay (infra): Ops note: rotation procedure: 1) create new salt encrypted in KMS 2) set tenant.salt_active=v2 3) optionally re-hash historical indices if customer requests — heavy. Add a cost/impact flag in UI.
jules (customer-success): For support readiness: create a short playbook: how to verify preview, how to repro missing fields, how to disable quickly if it breaks their parsers.
maria (eng-security): Action items: @ajay implement KMS-backed salt store + API (owner: ajay) ; @sarah add preview webhook + replay UI (owner: sarah) ; @maria update schema & docs + draft customer-facing onboarding email (owner: maria) ; @jules draft playbook (owner: jules).
ajay (infra): I can start a PR for KMS salt API — will include sample key policy and a migration script example.
sarah (prod-ops): I'll wire up preview endpoint and a boolean toggle in onboarding flows. ETA EOW for internal preview.
maria (eng-security): Great. One more: include a small sample payload for docs (pseudonymize=true):
```
{
  "event_time": "2026-03-20T14:01:02Z",
  "action": "api_key.created",
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "user_pseudonym": "3f7a1e4b...",
  "user_present": true,
  "resource": "key_abc123"
}
```

maria (eng-security): And sample webhook signature check snippet for customers: `sig = HMAC_SHA256(webhook_secret, raw_body); compare_hex(sig, header_value)`
jules (customer-success): Thanks — I'll start a templated onboarding email referencing the preview mode and FAQs.
maria (eng-security): OK closing for now — ping this thread if blockers come up. :lock:
